cues: About six days after fertilisation a tadpole hatches.
At first it has external gills and no mouth, living on its yolk.
Then a mouth opens and it becomes a plant eater, and a fold of skin covers internal gills.
Hind legs appear, then front legs; lungs replace the gills; the tail is digested away; and the gut shortens as it turns carnivore.
Two to three months, egg to froglet.
text: About six days after fertilisation a tadpole hatches. At first it has external gills and no mouth, living on its yolk. Then a mouth opens and it becomes a plant eater, and a fold of skin covers internal gills. Hind legs appear, then front legs; lungs replace the gills; the tail is digested away; and the gut shortens as it turns carnivore. Two to three months, egg to froglet.
